cards.title: Casts, shapes, modules
cards.text: Three casts. Each is one shape plus slots. Any module in any slot.
cards.why: This is the core of the game. Mark any part that doesn't sit right.

parts.title: Casts
parts.text: What you trigger: Weapon (Fire stick), Summon (Summon stick), Dash (Dash button).

parts.title: Five shapes
parts.text: Bolt: a fast shot. Beam: a held line. Burst: a lobbed bomb that blasts a circle. Ball: a thrown body with HP that hits by contact, harder when faster. Self: the dash, your own body moving.

parts.title: Starting kit
parts.text: Weapon = Bolt, Summon = Ball, Dash = Self. Beam and Burst come from unlocks and from shape cards in chests.

parts.title: Shape cards
parts.text: A shape card swaps a cast's shape and keeps its modules. Bolt + Bounce + Burn becomes Beam + Bounce + Burn: a burning beam that reflects.

parts.title: Slots
parts.text: Weapon 3, Summon 2, Dash 2 at the start. Unlocks raise them to 6, 5 and 4.

cards.title: Any module, any shape
cards.text: Every shape answers the same seven questions. Modules are written against those, never against a shape.
cards.why: This is your 'make modules generic' test. If a module ever had no answer on a shape, this is where it would break.

parts.title: Count
parts.text: How many per cast. Bolts, beams, bombs, balls, or dash charges.

parts.title: Size
parts.text: Bolt radius, beam width, blast radius, ball size and HP, dash width.

parts.title: Speed
parts.text: Flight speed and reload, beam reach and tick rate, throw speed, ball speed and charge rate, dash length and recharge.

parts.title: Path
parts.text: How it moves: the flight, the line, the lob, the throw then drift, the dash line.

parts.title: Contact
parts.text: Touching an enemy: the hit, each beam tick, everything in the blast, each ball collision, everyone you dash through or shove.

parts.title: Wall
parts.text: Touching a wall: a bolt dies, a beam stops, a blast is blocked, a ball thuds, a dash stops.

parts.title: End
parts.text: When it's over: a bolt runs out, a beam is released, a blast fades, a ball dies, a dash ends.

parts.title: Fallbacks
parts.text: Where the obvious answer is 'nothing', the module names a fallback. Shrapnel on a dash: a ring of bolts where you land. No module ever does nothing.

cards.title: What children inherit
cards.text: Some modules make new things: a blast, small bolts, copies. Those carry some of the parent's modules.
cards.why: This is your maze doc's rule 20, unchanged. It's what lets a burning ball's turret shots burn without you adding Burn twice.

parts.title: Payloads pass down
parts.text: Burn, Chill, Shock, Poison, Mark, Knock, Pull and Leech pass to children. A burning ball's Gunner shots burn; its death blast is a fire blast.

parts.title: Nothing else does
parts.text: Path, count and spawner modules don't pass down. That stops endless chains and keeps the screen readable.

parts.title: Splits stop
parts.text: Split children never split again.

parts.title: Depth limit
parts.text: Things making things making things: 2 deep in a run, 3 with an unlock.

cards.title: Runes: spells in spells
cards.text: A Rune is a module with a trigger and an empty socket. Put a shape card in it, and 2 modules of its own.
cards.why: This is how your Wings-sized spells become buildable. Fixed spawners (Explode, Gunner…) are runes that come pre-filled.

parts.title: How it works
parts.text: 'On wall: cast ___'. Drop in Burst, add Pull and Chill: every time your bolt hits a wall, a freezing blast sucks enemies in.

parts.title: Triggers
parts.text: On hit, On wall, On end, Every 1 s, On kill. The trigger is fixed when the Rune drops; it's printed on the card.

parts.title: Rarity
parts.text: Epic or better only. A run might see two or three.

cards.title: Levels, rarity, slots
cards.text: How modules grow and how many you carry.
cards.why: The questions after this card are about these numbers.

parts.title: Numbers shown
parts.text: Upgrade cards show the number: 'Bounce 2 → 3'.

parts.title: Rarity caps levels
parts.text: Common 3, Rare 5, Epic 7, Legendary 9.

parts.title: Duplicates
parts.text: The same module at a higher rarity promotes yours, keeping levels. Same or lower rarity: +1 level, or scrap it for XP.

parts.title: When full
parts.text: A new module can replace one you have (the old one is scrapped for XP), or be scrapped itself.

parts.title: Moving
parts.text: On the build screen you can move any module between casts. Its level goes with it.

parts.title: Level-up
parts.text: 4 cards, mostly modules below their cap. When everything's capped: vitals like +10 max HP.
